## Checklist

- [ ] Linked an accepted issue above, or this is a small fix
- [ ] I have read and run every line of this change, and can answer questions about it
- [ ] Ran `pnpm check` (lint, typecheck, tests) locally
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this changes behavior
- [ ] Updated docs if this changes a user-facing surface
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to license my contribution under the project's terms (CLA)

---

### After you open this PR

- A maintainer will review your PR if it is a small fix or links an accepted issue. If you don't hear back within a few business days, a comment to nudge is welcome.
- When your change is accepted, this PR closes automatically — that's how it merges, and your authorship is preserved.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
